name: Controlling People
overview: Scripture reveals that true strength lies in self-control, as one who masters their own spirit is greater than one who conquers a city, while lacking such control leaves a person vulnerable like a city without walls. Believers are urged to walk in the Spirit to overcome fleshly desires and to cultivate the fruit of the Spirit, including love, patience, and gentleness. Controlling one’s tongue is essential for genuine faith, and Christians are instructed to avoid those who cause divisions and oppose sound doctrine, demonstrating the importance of spiritual discipline in both personal conduct and community relationships.
